summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent: Align the cache evictor with the same window the freshness check uses, so a reloaded tile does not survive eviction. The user also forbade force-pushing this branch, because other people work on it.
2. Key Files: cache/evict.go (eviction now calls the shared predicate).
3. Errors: one commit attempt stopped on a leftover lock and went through on the retry.
4. Commands: git commit -am (one file changed).
5. Next: none pending.
